description: Return ready-to-post LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and newsletter blurbs a founder can copy-paste to announce what they learned validating an idea with Vouch. Use when the user says they finished interviews, want to 'build in public', 'share results', 'post an update', or 'tell people what I learned'. Provide the founder's headline (idea in one sentence) and the top insight or number they want to highlight.

headline.description: One-sentence framing of the idea, e.g. 'AI copilot for pastry chefs'.

insight.description: The single most compelling insight/number from validation, e.g. '8 of 10 chefs said they'd pay $49/mo, but only 2 for real-time alerts'.

projectId.description: Optional Vouch project id to link the public report card.

referralCode.description: Optional 8-char Vouch referral code to append so the founder earns credit and a Pro trial for every signup from the post.

name: get_share_kit
